status: Original Barrier-first alternative; not the default solo-leveling recommendation. Legal under extracted tree; no comparative leveling optimization.
assumptions: First character; mostly solo questing with occasional dungeons
One normal talent point per level from 10; no bonus Legacy points
No mandatory respec; Barrier at 40; Missile Barrage comes later to preserve that milestone
Frostbite intentionally omitted for predictable pack control; emergency/control utility is not scored by the damage sim

segments.why: Reach 5/5. Faster core casts.
Reach 2/3. General hit support; not a raid hit-cap target.
Reach 3/3. More reliable spacing while questing.
Unlock. Use on frozen targets or with Fingers of Frost, not every time it is ready.
Reach 3/3. Reduce Frost spell mana costs.
First point, 1/5.
Unlock emergency immunity. It is not a guaranteed escape or threat reset.
Reach 3/3. Improve crit chance against frozen targets.
First point, 1/2.
Reach 2/2. Learn to spend frozen charges.
Unlock a Frost cooldown reset. Keep it available for danger while learning.
Finish 2/2.
Second point, 2/5.
Reach 5/5. Builds toward Cone of Cold; do not run into a dangerous pack just to use it.
Unlock the shield and the current offensive Frost aura.
Reach 5/5 in Arcane, opening the next tier for Barrage.
Reach 2/2. Use the free, faster Missiles channel when safe to stand still.
Reach 5/5 for Clearcasting.
Finish 5/5.
Reach 3/3. Add controlled pack/dungeon slows; this does not make large pulls safe.
Reach 2/3. Finish at 12 Arcane / 0 Fire / 39 Frost.

guide_review.finding: Early mana and Frostbite recommendations differ materially from this alternative. No-respec and Barrier-at-40 constraints were authored, not requested or optimized.
guide_review.remaining: Evaluate complete alternative orders and respec timing before changing the interactive allocation. No claim that guide popularity establishes optimality.
